youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 27:1 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Afraid of something today? Read this first.

"The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?" Psalm 27:1 (KJV)

When he's your light, the dark parts of the day don't get to run you.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
